scripts.start:prod: npm run stop:3000:node && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=production node index.js
scripts.test:prep: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEBUG_AUTH=0 DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db node tools/test-reset-db.js
scripts.test: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEBUG_AUTH=0 DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db npm run test:prep && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEBUG_AUTH=0 DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db jest
scripts.test:watch: npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEBUG_AUTH=0 DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db npm run test:prep && npx cross-env NODE_ENV=test DEBUG_AUTH=0 DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db jest --watchAll
scripts.db:reset:dev: npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate
scripts.db:reset:test: npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/test.db prisma migrate reset --force --skip-generate
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npx cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/prod.db prisma migrate deploy
